what: Does the frozen-feature peritumoral gain (+0.075, 10/10 seeds, p=0.002) survive end-to-end training with model.peritumoral_features=true?
answer: Consistently positive (3/3 seeds, +0.047/+0.059/+0.067) but not significant. Reported as suggestive.
resolution: The seed-1337 BASELINE originally had a stalled fold, which made the answer depend on whether that seed was included (+0.028 p=0.34 on n=122 vs +0.068 p=0.048 on n=153). Rather than pick, the degenerate baseline was retrained as base-s1337-rerun (0.643, no stalled folds, n=153). On the clean all-3-seed analysis the delta is +0.058 with p=0.086 -- so the earlier p=0.048 was a selection artifact of dropping a seed, and was correctly not relied upon.
